chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Anbasa al-Abid, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who said:
Beware of arguing in religion, for indeed it distracts the heart from the remembrance of God, Mighty and Majestic, and it bequeaths hypocrisy, and it forms grudges, and it makes lying easy.

key_terms.الخصومة: Disputation, quarreling, contentious arguing about religious matters
key_terms.النفاق: Hypocrisy, outward conformity without inner conviction
key_terms.ذكر الله: Remembrance of God, the spiritual practice of keeping God in one's awareness

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about arguing in religion?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) warned against religious argumentation, identifying four spiritual harms: it distracts the heart from God's remembrance, breeds hypocrisy, generates grudges, and normalizes lying. This teaching was delivered during the mid-2nd century AH, a period of intense theological debates between various Islamic schools, making this warning particularly timely.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
